verified_key_information_units.information: Travel demand trends showed significant growth to Spain (149% increase in passengers to Malaga, Barcelona, and Mallorca compared to 2022) and an 8% rise in long-haul travel. Operational performance improved materially in Q4 2024, with adjusted EBITDA reaching EUR 2.3 million and a load factor of 98.9% (compared to 96.7% in Q4 2023). This improvement followed optimization of the travel program and better destination management, reducing the share of last-minute trips which negatively impact financial results.
